title: Scale phase 2: hidden-items list and tag counts in Ranked
description: design/scale.md phase 2, the parts that lose no features (the user chose this 2026-09-27; tab paging and handles on demand wait for phase 3 search). The ranking Lambda keeps a 'hidden' list (scores, and carded samples/clips, using a sample whose recording has no documented license; fed by Recording, Sample and ScoreRef streams too) and a 'tags' list (one row per tag with its score count). hiddenIds() and flagged scores read the hidden list instead of listing every Clip, ScoreRef, Recording and Sample; home's tag strip and /tags read the tags list instead of every Score. Local mode computes both. Update design/scale.md.
